content: {"question":"If an employee moves from GitLab BV (Belgium) to GitLab Canada Corp, how does the maximum paid sick leave differ between the two entities?","answer":"Belgium offers 30 days of full salary continuation, while Canada provides only 10 days of paid sick leave per year.","evidence_a":"30 days full salary continuation (regardless of seniority)","evidence_b":"Annual Allowance: 10 days per year (3 days available after first month of employment)"}
